hadi-march/ui#ThemeMenu.name: ThemeMenu
hadi-march/ui#ThemeMenu.doc: One menu for appearance, color theme and accent: `<ThemeMenu />` (or `<ThemeMenu themes={false} accents={["primary", "brand-blue"]} />`).

props.name: label
props.doc: Button label (default "Appearance").

props.name: themes
props.doc: Show the color themes (default true).

props.name: accents
props.doc: Accent choices; false hides the accent section (default: ACCENT_CHOICES).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Button icon: your own icon, or false for a text-only button (default: the palette).

props.name: modes
props.doc: Show light / dark / system (default true).

props.name: view
props.doc: How the themes are drawn: "list" (default: rows with a swatch) or "cards" (a grid of preview cards, each a small page drawn by the theme).

props.name: current
props.doc: The button shows the current theme: its swatch and its name (default false: the icon alone).

props.name: headings
props.doc: Show the "Theme" / "Accent" section headings (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { theme?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; accent?: MaybeFn<string | undefined> } | undefined
props.doc: Section heading texts (defaults "Theme", "Accent").

props.name: value
props.doc: A theme of its own instead of the page's (a preview drawn in another theme, with `m:theme`): the menu shows `value` and calls `onChange`; the page's theme is not touched.

props.name: page
props.doc: With `value`: a first entry "Page theme" (the value `""`): the preview follows the page's theme.

props.name: mode
props.doc: Light or dark the swatches and cards are drawn in (with `value`: the preview's mode; default the page's).

props.name: size
props.doc: Button size (default "md"; "sm" for a slim toolbar).

props.name: panelClass
props.doc: Class of the opened panel (next to `m-theme-menu`).

hadi-march/ui#ThemeMenu.tr: Görünüm, renk teması ve vurgu için tek menü: `<ThemeMenu />` (ya da `<ThemeMenu themes={false} accents={["primary", "brand-blue"]} />`).

hadi-march/ui#ThemePicker.name: ThemePicker
hadi-march/ui#ThemePicker.doc: Theme menu: color themes (with live swatches) and light / dark / system. `<ThemePicker />`
hadi-march/ui#ThemePicker.tr: Tema menüsü: renk temaları (canlı örneklerle) ve açık / koyu / sistem. `<ThemePicker />`

hadi-march/ui#ThemePreview.name: ThemePreview
hadi-march/ui#ThemePreview.doc: A small page drawn by a theme itself (ground, two surfaces, an accent bar, its text colour and corner): the picture of a theme card.
hadi-march/ui#ThemePreview.signature: function ThemePreview(props: { id: string; class?: ClassProp; /** Light or dark of its own (default the page's). */ mode?: MaybeFn<"light" | "dark" | null | undefined> }): Element

params.name: props
params.type: { id: string; class?: ClassProp; /** Light or dark of its own (default the page's). */ mode?: MaybeFn<"light" | "dark" | null | undefined> }

hadi-march/ui#ThemePreview.tr: Temanın kendisinin çizdiği küçük sayfa (zemin, iki yüzey, vurgu çubuğu, yazı rengi ve köşesi): tema kartının resmi.

hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.name: ThemeSwatch
hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.doc: Small preview of a theme drawn by the theme itself (data-m-theme scope; no inline styles).
hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.signature: function ThemeSwatch(props: { id: string; class?: ClassProp; /** Light or dark of its own (default the page's). */ mode?: MaybeFn<"light" | "dark" | null | undefined> }): Element

params.name: props
params.type: { id: string; class?: ClassProp; /** Light or dark of its own (default the page's). */ mode?: MaybeFn<"light" | "dark" | null | undefined> }

hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.tr: Temanın kendisi tarafından çizilen küçük tema önizlemesi (data-m-theme kapsamı; satır içi stil yok).

props.name: value
props.doc: A mode of its own instead of the page's (a preview drawn light or dark): shows `value`, calls `onChange`.

hadi-march/ui#TimeInput.name: TimeInput
hadi-march/ui#TimeInput.doc: Native time input; value "HH:MM". Props: min, max, step (seconds).

props.name: step
props.doc: Seconds.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#TimeInput.tr: Yerel saat girdisi; değer "HH:MM". Prop'lar: min, max, step (saniye).

hadi-march/ui#timelineCode.name: timelineCode
hadi-march/ui#timelineCode.doc: Engine timeline code for a model (what the editor plays), e.g. for the Code view.
hadi-march/ui#timelineCode.tr: Bir model için motor zaman çizelgesi kodu (düzenleyicinin oynattığı), örn. Kod görünümü için.

hadi-march/ui#toast.name: toast
hadi-march/ui#toast.doc: Show a toast. `timeout` in ms (0 = stays until dismissed). Default: 4s, 8s with an action or for danger.
hadi-march/ui#toast.signature: const toast: (message: unknown, opts?: ToastOptions) => number
hadi-march/ui#toast.tr: Bildirim gösterir. `timeout` ms cinsinden (0 = kapatılana dek kalır). Varsayılan: 4 sn, eylemli ya da tehlike bildiriminde 8 sn.

hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.name: ToastHost
hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.doc: Renders the toast stack. Place once near the root of the app (optional): `<ToastHost position="top-center" />`.
hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.signature: function ToastHost(props: { /** Corner (or centre) of the screen the stack sits in (default "bottom-end"; start / end follow the writing direction). */ position?: "bottom-end" | "bottom-start" | "bottom-center" | "top-end" | "top-start" | "top-center" | undefined; class?: ClassProp; } = {}): Element

params.name: props
params.type: { /** Corner (or centre) of the screen the stack sits in (default "bottom-end"; start / end follow the writing direction). */ position?: "bottom-end" | "bottom-start" | "bottom-center" | "top-end" | "top-start" | "top-center" | undefined; class?: ClassProp; }

props.name: position
props.doc: Corner (or centre) of the screen the stack sits in (default "bottom-end"; start / end follow the writing direction).

hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.tr: Bildirim yığınını çizer. Uygulamanın köküne yakın bir kez yerleştirin (isteğe bağlı).

hadi-march/ui#toastsFeature.name: toastsFeature
hadi-march/ui#toastsFeature.doc: A toast host owned by the layout (toasts also work without it: the first toast() makes one).
hadi-march/ui#toastsFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: Layout'a ait bir bildirim alanı (bildirimler onsuz da çalışır).

hadi-march/ui#todayIso.name: todayIso
hadi-march/ui#todayIso.doc: Today as an ISO date in local time.
hadi-march/ui#todayIso.tr: Bugün, yerel saatte ISO tarihi olarak.

hadi-march/ui#Toggle.name: Toggle
hadi-march/ui#Toggle.doc: On / off switch (role="switch"); `tristate`: on / off / not set (role="checkbox", aria-checked="mixed" when not set).

props.name: tristate
props.doc: Three states: on, off and "not set" (null, the thumb in the middle): for a prop where unset differs from false (a toggle button's `pressed`). A click goes not set → on → off → not set. Default false (two states).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#tokenize.name: tokenize
hadi-march/ui#tokenize.doc: Split source into coloured tokens. Unknown languages give one plain token.
hadi-march/ui#tokenize.signature: function tokenize(src: string, lang: string = ""): Token[]
hadi-march/ui#tokenize.tr: Kaynağı renkli belirteçlere böler. Bilinmeyen diller tek düz belirteç verir.

hadi-march/ui#tokenizeCommand.name: tokenizeCommand
hadi-march/ui#tokenizeCommand.doc: Split a line into words: "double" and 'single' quotes keep spaces, \ escapes the next character.
hadi-march/ui#tokenizeCommand.tr: Bir komut satırını sözcüklere böler: çift ve tek tırnak boşlukları korur, \ sonraki karakteri kaçırır.

hadi-march/ui#tokenLines.name: tokenLines
hadi-march/ui#tokenLines.doc: Tokens split into lines (a token spanning lines is cut at each newline).
hadi-march/ui#tokenLines.signature: function tokenLines(src: string, lang: string = ""): Token[][]
hadi-march/ui#tokenLines.tr: Satırlara bölünmüş belirteçler (birden çok satıra yayılan belirteç her satır sonunda kesilir).

hadi-march/ui#toneIcon.name: toneIcon
hadi-march/ui#toneIcon.doc: The icon of a tone (info, success, warn, danger, neutral), shared by everything that shows a message in a tone (Alert, Toast).
hadi-march/ui#toneIcon.signature: function toneIcon(tone: string | null | undefined): IconDef
hadi-march/ui#toneIcon.tr: Bir tonun (info, success, warn, danger, neutral) ikonunu verir; tonla ileti gösteren her bileşen (`Alert`, `Toast`) aynı tabloyu kullanır.

hadi-march/ui#Toolbar.name: Toolbar
hadi-march/ui#Toolbar.doc: Horizontal bar of controls: `<Toolbar label="Filters" end={<Button>…</Button>}>…</Toolbar>`

hadi-march/ui#Tooltip.name: Tooltip
hadi-march/ui#Tooltip.doc: `<Tooltip text="Copy link" placement="top"><button>…</button></Tooltip>` — on hover and keyboard focus.

props.name: delay
props.doc: Hover delay before it shows, ms (default 300; keyboard focus shows it at once).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: true: it never shows (the wrapped element works as before).

props.name: motion
props.doc: Entrance motion: "scale" (default), "fade" or "none".

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token of the bubble (default: the inverse surface).

props.name: class
props.doc: Extra class on the bubble.

hadi-march/ui#Tooltip.tr: `<Tooltip text="Copy link" placement="top"><button>…</button></Tooltip>` — üzerine gelince ve klavye odağında gösterilir.

props.name: schema
props.doc: JSON Schema subset: types, properties, required, items, enum, ranges, lengths, pattern, format.

props.name: validate
props.doc: Extra checks → problems with their paths.

props.name: expand
props.doc: Levels open at start (default 2).

props.name: search
props.doc: Search box over the tree (default true).

props.name: history
props.doc: Undo / redo buttons and Ctrl+Z (default true).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the tree.

props.name: onValidate
props.doc: Called with every validation result.

props.name: status
props.doc: The "Valid" / "N problems" status in the bar (default true).

props.name: typeBadges
props.doc: The type badge of each row (default true; T on a row still opens the type menu).

props.name: actions
props.doc: Row actions: true (default: add, duplicate, delete), false, or the ones to keep. The keys (+, Delete) follow it.

props.name: labels
props.type: { root?: string; search?: string; valid?: string; problems?: (n: number) => string; noMatches?: string; undo?: string; redo?: string; key?: string; valueName?: (key: string) => string; emptyText?: string; items?: (n: number) => string; fields?: (n: number) => string; addInside?: string; addAfter?: string; duplicate?: string; delete?: string; changeType?: string; typeOf?: (kind: string) => string; kinds?: Partial<Record<"string" | "number" | "boolean" | "null" | "object" | "array", string>>; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; defaults are the translated ones. `kinds` names the types ("text", "number"…).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#typeOf.name: typeOf
hadi-march/ui#typeOf.doc: The type a value shows as (integers are "number").
hadi-march/ui#typeOf.tr: Bir değerin görünen türü (tam sayılar "number" olarak görünür).

hadi-march/ui#typeScriptPlugin.name: typeScriptPlugin
hadi-march/ui#typeScriptPlugin.tr: TypeScript dil servisi eklentisi: bir worker içinde çalışır; bütün JavaScript / TypeScript / DOM API tamamlaması, hata ve uyarıların yerleri. CSP Trusted Types ile çalışıyorsa trusted-types march-worker gerekir.

props.name: names
props.doc: Who is typing (names). Empty: the indicator hides.

props.name: variant
props.doc: bubble: dots in a chat bubble · inline: dots and text in a line. Default bubble.

props.name: text
props.doc: Show the "… is typing" text. Default true for inline, false for bubble (still announced).

props.name: label
props.doc: Your own sentence: `(names) => "…"`. Default: typingText ("HADİ is typing…").

props.name: dots
props.doc: The three dots: true (default), false (text only), or your own node in their place.

props.name: motion
props.doc: How the dots move: lift (default) · fade (no movement, they only light up in turn) · none (still).

hadi-march/ui#typingText.name: typingText
hadi-march/ui#typingText.doc: The sentence: "HADİ is typing…", "HADİ and Beta are typing…", "3 people are typing…".
hadi-march/ui#typingText.tr: Cümle: "HADİ is typing…", "HADİ and Beta are typing…", "3 people are typing…".

hadi-march/ui#UndoRedo.name: UndoRedo
hadi-march/ui#UndoRedo.doc: `<UndoRedo history={stack} />`, `<UndoRedo canUndo={$past.length > 0} canRedo={$future.length > 0} onUndo={undo} onRedo={redo} size="sm" />`

props.name: history
props.doc: An undo stack: replaces canUndo / canRedo / onUndo / onRedo and names the steps.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Which buttons, in this order (default: undo, redo).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own names (default "Undo", "Redo", group "History"; translated).

props.name: steps
props.type: Partial<Record<UndoRedoAction, MaybeFn<string | null | undefined>>> | false | undefined
props.doc: Name of the step each button would act on ("Undo: Rename"); default: from `history.past` / `future`. false: never.

props.name: shortcuts
props.doc: Shortcut shown in the tooltip: true (default: mod+z, mod+shift+z), false, or your own combos.

props.name: partClass
props.doc: An extra class on a button, for a host that keeps its own class names: `{ undo, redo }`.

hadi-march/ui#UndoRedo.tr: Düzenleyicinin geri al / yinele düğme çifti; ipucunda adımın adı ve kısayol yazar: `<UndoRedo history={stack} />`

hadi-march/ui#updateAt.name: updateAt
hadi-march/ui#updateAt.doc: A copy of `root` with `fn(old)` at `p` (only the containers on the way are copied).
hadi-march/ui#updateAt.signature: function updateAt(root: unknown, p: JsonPath, fn: (old: unknown) => unknown): unknown
hadi-march/ui#updateAt.tr: `root` değerinin, `p` konumunda `fn(old)` olan bir kopyası (yalnızca yoldaki kapsayıcılar kopyalanır).

hadi-march/ui#UpdateBanner.name: UpdateBanner
hadi-march/ui#UpdateBanner.doc: Shows "A new version is available · Reload" when the text at `url` changes (deploys write a build id there). Polls every `every` minutes and when the tab becomes visible. `<UpdateBanner url="/build.txt" every={5} />`

props.name: url
props.doc: Build id URL (default "/build.txt").

props.name: every
props.doc: Poll interval in minutes (default 5).

hadi-march/ui#UpdateBanner.tr: `url` adresindeki metin değişince (yayınlar oraya bir yapı kimliği yazar) "Yeni sürüm var · Yenile" bildirimini gösterir. Her `every` dakikada bir ve sekme görünür olunca yoklar. `<UpdateBanner url="/build.txt" every={5} />`

hadi-march/ui#UrlInput.name: UrlInput
hadi-march/ui#UrlInput.doc: Text input for a web address (url keyboard, https:// placeholder).

props.name: onPaste
props.doc: Paste handler (e.g. split pasted lines into items; `preventDefault()` keeps the text out of the input).

props.name: error
props.doc: An error text of the input itself, for an input without a `<Field>`: while it has text the input is invalid and the text is shown under it (`role="alert"`, linked with `aria-describedby`). Pass `null` / `""` while there is no error.

props.name: errorSpace
props.doc: With `error`: the error line keeps its height while there is no error, so nothing moves when one appears.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#UrlInput.tr: Web adresi için metin girişi (url klavyesi, https:// yer tutucusu).

hadi-march/ui#usageOf.name: usageOf
hadi-march/ui#usageOf.signature: function usageOf(name: string, args: readonly ArgSpec[] = [], options: Record<string, OptionSpec> = {}): string
hadi-march/ui#usageOf.tr: Bir komut tanımından kullanım satırı üretir: "deploy <env> [tag] [--force]".

hadi-march/ui#useForm.name: useForm
hadi-march/ui#useForm.doc: Form state and behaviour for a schema.
hadi-march/ui#useForm.signature:
function useForm<V>(sch: Schema<V>, initial?: Initial<V>, opts?: FormOptions<V>): FormController<V>
function useForm<S extends SchemaSpec>(spec?: S | null, initial?: Initial<SpecValues<S>>, opts?: FormOptions<SpecValues<S>>): FormController<SpecValues<S>>
function useForm<V = Values>(sch?: Schema<V> | SchemaSpec | null, initial?: Initial<V>, opts?: FormOptions<V>): FormController<V>

params.name: sch
params.doc: a schema() or a plain spec

params.name: initial
params.doc: values (or a function returning them) over the schema defaults

params.name: opts
params.doc: onSubmit(values, form), validateOn ("blur" | "change" | "submit"), onChange(name, value, values), onInvalid(errors)

hadi-march/ui#useForm.tr: Bir şema için form durumu ve davranışı.

hadi-march/ui#useLayout.name: useLayout
hadi-march/ui#useLayout.doc: The Layout around this code, or null.
hadi-march/ui#useLayout.tr: Bu kodu saran Layout'un API'si, yoksa null.

hadi-march/ui#UserMenu.name: UserMenu
hadi-march/ui#UserMenu.doc: Account button with a menu: `<UserMenu name="Ada" detail="ada@x.com" items={[profile, "-", signOut]} />`

props.name: compact
props.doc: Only the avatar (narrow places such as an icon rail or a top bar).

hadi-march/ui#UserMenu.tr: Menülü hesap düğmesi: `<UserMenu name="Ada" detail="ada@x.com" items={[profile, "-", signOut]} />`

hadi-march/ui#validateJson.name: validateJson
hadi-march/ui#validateJson.doc: Check `value` against `schema`; every problem with its path.
hadi-march/ui#validateJson.signature: function validateJson(value: unknown, schema: JsonSchema | undefined, path: JsonPath = []): JsonError[]
hadi-march/ui#validateJson.tr: `value` değerini `schema` şemasına karşı denetler; her sorunu yoluyla birlikte döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#validateRecords.name: validateRecords
hadi-march/ui#validateRecords.doc: First problem in a list of records, or null.
hadi-march/ui#validateRecords.signature: function validateRecords(list: readonly (Values | null | undefined)[] | null | undefined, fields: RecordFields | null | undefined): string | null
hadi-march/ui#validateRecords.tr: Kayıt listesindeki ilk sorunu döndürür, yoksa null.

hadi-march/ui#VerifiedMark.name: VerifiedMark

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default "Verified"); `false`: decorative (the text beside it says it).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Own icon (an icon of hadi-march/icons, text or a node).

props.name: size
props.doc: sm (beside body text, default) · md (beside a heading) · lg.

hadi-march/ui#VerifiedMark.tr: Adın yanındaki doğrulanmış hesap rozeti (erişilebilir adıyla bir resim); ikonu, metni, rengi ve boyutu değiştirilebilir: `<VerifiedMark size="md" />`.

hadi-march/ui#Widget.name: Widget
hadi-march/ui#Widget.doc: Draw a widget point: `<Widget sources={[codeView]} input={{ source, lang: "tsx" }} />`. The input is live: when it changes (`input={{ source: $code }}`), the provider draws again for the new input.
hadi-march/ui#Widget.tr: Bir widget noktası çizer: `<Widget sources={[codeView]} input={{ source, lang: "tsx" }} />`.

hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.name: widgetPoint
hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.doc: Create (or get, by id) a widget point. `defaults` are always present and lose ties to later providers.
hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.signature:
function widgetPoint

(id: string, opts?: { defaults?: readonly WidgetProvider

[] }): WidgetPoint
hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.tr: Bir widget noktası oluşturur (veya kimliğiyle getirir). `defaults` her zaman bulunur ve sonraki sağlayıcılarla eşitlikte kaybeder.

hadi-march/ui#Window.name: Window
hadi-march/ui#Window.doc: A window in its area: move, resize, dock to an edge, minimize, fill, close; Windows, Mac or HADİ look.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon node before the title.

props.name: chrome
props.doc: Look of the frame (default "hadi").

props.name: x
props.doc: Start place and size in px (default: 32 × 20 rem, centered).

props.name: state
props.doc: Start state, or a live one with onStateChange.

props.name: open
props.doc: Shown while true (live); without it the close button removes the window until it is rendered again.

props.name: minimizable
props.doc: Buttons to show (default all three).

props.name: movable
props.doc: false: fixed in place (the buttons still work).

props.name: snap
props.doc: Dock when dragged to an edge (default true).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Keep place, size and state in localStorage under "m.win.<persist>".

props.name: labels
props.type: { close?: string; minimize?: string; restore?: string; maximize?: string; move?: string; moveHint?: string } | undefined
props.doc: Texts of the buttons and the title bar (the defaults are translated).

props.name: icons
props.type: { close?: unknown; minimize?: unknown; maximize?: unknown; restore?: unknown } | undefined
props.doc: Your own button icons: an icon, a text or a node each.

props.name: color
props.doc: Accent of the frame: the title icon, the button hover and the dock preview (default: the accent).

props.name: stripe
props.doc: The brand stripe of the "hadi" look (default true).

props.name: animated
props.doc: false: place and size change at once, without a transition (default true).

hadi-march/ui#Window.tr: Alanı içinde taşınır, boyutlanır pencere: kenara kenetlenir, küçülür, alanı kaplar, kapanır; HADİ, Mac ya da Windows görünümü.

hadi-march/ui#Wizard.name: Wizard
hadi-march/ui#Wizard.doc: Props: steps [{ title, description, fields?: [names], schema?: schema(), validate?(values) → {name: msg} | string | null, render?(form) → node }], schema (optional when every step has its own), initial, onSubmit(values), submitLabel, layout, cols, onStep(index), form (an existing useForm).

props.name: schema
props.doc: Optional when every step has its own schema.

props.name: form
props.doc: An existing useForm() controller.

props.name: stepper
props.doc: The stage list on top (Steps): default true.

props.name: progress
props.doc: The progress bar under the stage list: default true.

props.name: count
props.doc: The "Step 2 of 3" text beside the buttons: default true.

props.name: backButton
props.doc: The Back button: default true.

props.name: labels
props.type: { back?: unknown; next?: unknown; step?: ((index: number) => string) | undefined; count?: ((index: number, total: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts: the buttons, the title of a step without one, and the "Step 2 of 3" text (index is 0-based).

hadi-march/ui#Wizard.tr: Prop'lar: steps [{ title, description, fields?: [names], schema?: schema(), validate?(values) → {name: msg} | string | null, render?(form) → node }], schema (her adımın kendi şeması varsa isteğe bağlı), initial ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/table#CellEditor.name: CellEditor
hadi-march/table#CellEditor.doc: Inline cell editor for a table's current edit (`table.editing()`): the form control of the column type (text, number, date, select, checkbox), Enter saves, Escape cancels, the validation message under it. Shared by <Table> and DataGrid. `onKey` runs first; call `e.preventDefault()` there to replace the default handling of a key (DataGrid: Tab saves and moves on).
hadi-march/table#CellEditor.signature: function CellEditor<R>(table: TableState<R>, col: TableColumn<R>, row: R, idBase: string, onKey?: (e: KeyboardEvent) => void): Element

props.name: format
props.type: (row: R, col: TableColumn<R> | Column<R> | string) => unknown

props.name: moveColumn
props.doc: Move among visible columns by `delta` positions (hidden columns are skipped).

props.name: runBulk
props.doc: Run a bulk action with the selected rows; clears the selection when it ran successfully. Errors are swallowed (the action reports them).

hadi-march/table#CellEditor.tr: Tablonun geçerli düzenlemesi (`table.editing()`) için satır içi hücre düzenleyici: sütun türüne göre input / select / checkbox; Enter kaydeder, Escape iptal eder, doğrulama iletisi altında görünür. <Table> ve DataGrid tarafından ortak kullanılır.

hadi-march/table#createTable.name: createTable
hadi-march/table#createTable.doc: Headless table. Options: rows | source, columns | schema, rowKey ("id"), pageSize (25), pageSizes, paging (true | false | "cursor"), paramNames, sort, filters, search, storageKey, urlKey, urlDelay, virtual (true | "auto"), virtualThreshold, onEdit, exportAll, filename, queryKey, loading, error.
hadi-march/table#createTable.tr: Başsız (headless) tablo. Seçenekler: rows | source, columns | schema, rowKey ("id"), pageSize (25), pageSizes, paging (true | false | "cursor"), paramNames, sort, filters, search, storageKey, urlKey, urlDelay, virtual ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/table#createVirtual.name: createVirtual
hadi-march/table#createVirtual.doc: Reactive window over `count()` rows. Call `onScroll(el)` from the scroll container's "scroll" event.
hadi-march/table#createVirtual.tr: `count()` satır üzerinde tepkisel pencere. Kaydırma kapsayıcısının "scroll" olayından `onScroll(el)` çağrılır.

hadi-march/table#csvField.name: csvField
hadi-march/table#csvField.doc: Quote one CSV field (RFC 4180). With `safe`, text starting with = + - @ is prefixed so spreadsheets do not run it.
